profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | J2EE | Microservice | Spring Boot | DevOps
profile.summary:
Over a 14 years of experience working in domains like Banking and Finance, Government, Live auction
and News distribution at project and product-based companies.

Outstanding fast Learning ability, excellent problem solving and programming skills with great
dedication, teamwork and excellent communication skills.

Experienced in working closely with clients on project proposals, requirement specifications, technical
solution documents and deployment.

Hands on experience in building large scale distributed systems with strong application lifecycle skills
including analysis, design, application development, maintenance, unit testing and maintaining code
quality.

Good in business management, Business Requirements, Functional and Non-Functional requirements,
Change management Business Impact Assessment and Go Live support

Great hands-on experience in Data Structure, Algorithms, Java, J2EE, Spring core, Spring MVC, Spring
boot, Microservices, Liferay, JSF, EJB, REST/SOAP services, Hibernate, Oracle, MySql, SQL, No SQL,
Splunk, Sonar

Share release management duties on future rollout

Good in business management, Business Requirements, Functional and Non-Functional requirements, Change management Business Impact Assessment, Employee Engagement and Go Live support

Methodology : Agile, Scrum, Kanban
Languages : Java, Python, Javascript, Groovy, HTML, XML
Technologies / Frameworks : J2EE, Grails, Spring, Spring MVC, Spring boot, Struts,
Liferay, Richfaces, Hibernate, EJB, JSP, Servlet, REST Webservice, JQuery
DevOps : Jenkins, Hudson, Team City, Maven, Docker, Nexus, Github
Tools : Jira, Confluence, Eclipse, Netbeans, Visual Source Code, IntelliJ IDEA,
Postman, Sonar, Splunk
Servers : WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss, Jetty
Database : MSSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, PostgreSQL
Platforms : Windows, Linux, MAC

positions.title: Sr Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Improved functionalities and pipeline integration by designing and implementing cross-platform frameworks.

Developed RESTful service for managing and querying news data.

Write, debug, test, and document high-availability software for web portals,
news release processing, metrics gathering and reporting, email distribution, and
other applications.

Creating fully automated CI build and deployment infrastructure using DevOps
tools including Build tools (Maven, Ant), Source control tools (GitHub, SVN),
CI/CD tools (Jenkins), Repository manager (Sonatype Nexus), Container
management (Docker)

Ensured tight cooperation with other engineers, designers, and artists through
active listening, systematic communication, and leadership skills.

Fixed bugs and problems across the entire Business Wire codebase in an
efficient, timely manner.

Working closely with Architecture, Development, Test, Security and IT Services
teams.

Identify project risks and work effectively to mitigate them.

Share release management responsibilities

App creation from scratch to automate process of monitoring news.

Technologies - Spring boot, J2EE, Spring MVC, Liferay, Docker, Splunk, REST web
services, Micro services, Oracle, MySQL, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Nexus

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Worked on a number of products working with Cognizant and the responsibility includes architecture, design, implementation, review, team mentoring, risk mitigation, scope management and client interfacing.

Help the team overcome its technical challenges by prioritizing and guiding them with my technical experience, conducting training/s as per requirement, discussing with domain experts and hand holding in terms of finding the right solution.

Providing technical direction in the company and build skills in bleeding edge technologies.

Active involvement in activities like mentoring to freshers, proposal development, hiring new members.

Technologies: Java, Spring, Hibernate, REST Webservices, JSF, Splunk, Team City, Sonar, Maven, Weblogic, Scrum methodology
